answer.explanation: From 21:22 (before the window) through 22:25, UploaderFunction logs repeated '[ERROR] NoSuchBucket ... PutObject ... The specified bucket does not exist' from handler.py line 29, about 195 errors per 5-minute bin during the window. Its execution role grants s3:PutObject only on arn:aws:s3:::lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi/*, so the IAM policy names a bucket that exists and is not the cause. NoSuchBucket means the bucket name the function actually uses does not exist, which points to the live OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable pointing at a wrong or missing bucket. The other three functions show only normal REPORT lines with no errors. No active alarms exist, and I could not read the Lambda configuration or the IaC template directly, so the exact value of OUTPUT_BUCKET is unverified.
